fusions.name: Signal Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart; each deals 14 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Length
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Its reach is 30% longer.

fusions.name: Long Commission
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Second Rank Looses
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second shot flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
